Regression in HWPX paragraph modification logic failed to invalidate layout cache elements.
The run regressed from 1.00 to 0.00 reward due to an AssertionError in test_modified_paragraphs_do_not_keep_layout_cache. Specifically, modified paragraphs in section0.xml and section1.xml still contained 'hp:linesegarray' elements, which should have been removed to prevent layout corruption. The verifier failed at /tests/test_outputs.py:65 with: 'assert <Element ...linesegarray> is None'. Avoid retaining stale HWPML layout metadata when performing text replacement or budget formatting.
